This land I am farming is not my own — I pay to use it — so I must think carefully about what to spend. But here in Iringa the rains are good and maize grows well if you feed it, so I will buy one bag of fertilizer from the agrodealer when planting and try to topdress if I have money left. I will also carry some manure from my goats to the plot before the rains. My sons help with weeding but at my age I cannot do land preparation alone, so I will pay a few young men for a week of hard work.
